name: Xinjiang Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., founded in 1960 and based in Urumqi, China, specializes in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of agricultural and animal husbandry equipment across the nation. The company offers a comprehensive array of farming solutions, marketed under its "Mushen" brand, which includes specialized machinery for corn and silage, chili cultivation, and various tillage processes. Their product portfolio further extends to harvesting implements, general farming equipment, tractors, systems for processing agricultural and sideline products, fruit machinery, power rotary harrows, and raisin processing equipment. Beyond its agricultural focus, the company also possesses significant expertise in aerospace manufacturing. It fabricates a diverse range of structural components for aircraft, such as frames, beams, ribs, wall panels, skins, long stringers, and shafts. For spacecraft, it produces intricate parts like thin-walled tubular sheet metal components, support rings, air inlets, nozzles, load-bearing elements, rudder and wing assemblies, projectile compartments, fairings, and components for both liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen engines. Additionally, their capabilities encompass engine and gas turbine structural components, including combustion chamber casings, flame tubes, external and intermediate casings, afterburner nozzles, integral blisks, blades, and various guide parts.
